summary: Reaparr is a cross-platform tool designed to facilitate downloading media between separate Plex servers. It automates the process of copying content collections from external libraries into your own local instance.
goodFor: It suits administrators who manage multiple Plex servers and want to automate the synchronisation or sharing of media libraries between them.
watchOut: Depending on your setup, copying media across servers can consume significant bandwidth and storage, and it may overlap with established download automation stacks.
deployNotes: Since it is distributed via Docker, you will typically need to map persistent volumes for configuration and media storage, and place it behind a reverse proxy if you require external TLS access.
